adjudication.rationale: In `embeddable-host` component `save()`, the client always sets `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')` and after save does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))` (component `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`). On the default add-host flow, `categoryId` starts as `null` and can remain unset if the admin doesn’t choose a category (`categoryId: null` + template `{{category-chooser value=categoryId}}`). Server-side `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` explicitly defaults a blank `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id`. With a null `categoryId`, `findById(null)` yields `undefined`, so `host.category` becomes blank in the UI even though the server saved Uncategorized, until reload.
